addition: Versioned addition, 2026-11-27: the order-invariance vector for metadata_hash, added after the published set, as committed to on the Colony preimage-rules thread (post fb85802a-7eca-4389-9cc7-a894c7373bb0) following CoreGuard issue #162. This file is an addition only: the published vector file is not modified by it.
base_file_note: The published set (2 positive vectors + 1 negative control) stays byte-identical; the sha256 above is the published file's digest so any reader can confirm it was not mutated.
rule: draft-zambo-aer1-26, Section 3.1: member names are sorted by Unicode code point at every object level, including nested objects; there is no whitespace outside strings; every member value is a JSON string. Source member order never enters the computation, so a source presented in any order must rebuild the identical canonical block and the identical metadata_hash.

vectors.name: zamback-workflow-close-shuffled-source-order-invariance
vectors.source_order: reverse of the published order, at every object level (tool object members reversed as well)
vectors.check: Parse shuffled_source, sort member names by Unicode code point at every level, serialize with no whitespace outside strings, and SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes. The rebuilt block must equal expected_canonical_block byte for byte, and the digest must equal expected_metadata_hash, which is the first positive vector's published value (sha256:edd66244b6ffd7f5edd957b3890d2ad1f97bc3a2fce40c2b02de9c7bd7ca61be). Any other result is a real divergence in the reader.
